jobs.title: Cybersecurity Intern
jobs.description: Cybersecurity Intern Company: Thinknovaa Location: Remote Duration: 3 Months Stipend: Up to ₹10,000 (Performance-Based) About the Role Thinknovaa is seeking motivated individuals to join its Cybersecurity Internship Program. This opportunity is designed for those interested in information security, ethical hacking, network security, threat detection, and protecting digital systems from potential vulnerabilities. Interns will gain practical experience through projects involving security assessments, vulnerability analysis, threat monitoring, and defensive security practices. Key Responsibilities Assist in identifying and analyzing security vulnerabilities in applications and networks. Perform basic vulnerability assessments and authorized security testing. Monitor and analyze security logs to identify potential threats. Explore Security Operations Center (SOC) workflows and incident response procedures. Assist in evaluating network security configurations and access controls. Work with cybersecurity tools for network analysis and vulnerability detection. Research emerging cyber threats, attack techniques, and security best practices. Document security findings and recommend appropriate mitigation measures. Collaborate on cybersecurity projects and maintain technical documentation. Skills & Qualifications Basic understanding of cybersecurity and information security principles. Familiarity with computer networks, TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP, and networking concepts. Knowledge of Linux, Windows, or command-line environments. Understanding of ethical hacking, vulnerability assessment, or penetration testing concepts. Familiarity with Wireshark, Nmap, Burp Suite, or similar security tools is beneficial. Basic knowledge of firewalls, encryption, authentication, and access control. Understanding of SOC operations, SIEM tools, or incident response is an advantage. Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving abilities, and attention to detail. Good communication skills and willingness to learn. Who Can Apply? Applications are welcome from: College students and recent graduates Freshers seeking practical cybersecurity experience Working professionals looking to strengthen their security skills Career switchers interested in cybersecurity and information security Internship Details This is a three-month remote internship focused on practical learning and project-based experience. The stipend is performance-based of upto 10,000 and subject to evaluation.

jobs.title: Assistant/Associate Professor in Computing Science (Cyber Security)
jobs.description: Join the British University of Bahrain as an Assistant/Associate Professor in Computing Science (Cyber Security) The British University of Bahrain (BUB) is seeking an outstanding academic to join our College of Engineering & Technology as an Assistant/Associate Professor in Computing Science - Cyber Security . This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to a growing institution that delivers internationally recognized UK degrees through its exclusive partnership with the University of Salford, Manchester . About the Role The successful candidate will contribute to teaching, research, academic administration, and the continued development of undergraduate and postgraduate Computing Science programmes, with a particular focus on Cyber Security. The role involves delivering high-quality teaching, supervising student projects, engaging in research and knowledge exchange activities, and supporting curriculum development. Key Responsibilities Deliver lectures, tutorials, workshops, and practical sessions in Computing Science and Cyber Security. Develop innovative teaching materials and assessments. Supervise undergraduate and postgraduate projects and internships. Contribute to programme design and enhancement. Undertake and publish high-quality research. Engage with industry partners and promote the external profile of the University. Provide academic mentorship and student support. Essential Qualifications Undergraduate degree in Computing Science, Cyber Security, or a closely related discipline. Postgraduate degree in Computing Science, Cyber Security, or a related field. PhD in Computing Science, Cyber Security, or a closely related discipline (or near completion). Experience teaching and assessing within UK Higher Education, or significant professional experience in Computing Science and Cyber Security. Desirable Qualifications & Experience Professional membership such as BCS or equivalent. Higher Education teaching qualification (PGCAP or equivalent). Experience in curriculum development and quality assurance processes. Expertise in programming, deep learning, web development, and cyber security research. What We're Looking For We are seeking a passionate educator and researcher with: Strong academic and industry knowledge in Computing Science and Cyber Security. A proven research portfolio and scholarly output. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills. A commitment to student success and academic excellence. Why Join BUB? At the British University of Bahrain, you'll become part of a diverse, inclusive, and forward-thinking academic community. Our unique partnership with the University of Salford enables us to offer internationally recognised UK qualifications while fostering innovation, research, and industry engagement in the Kingdom of Bahrain.

jobs.title: IT Audit Associate (CISA)
jobs.location: Abu Dhabi, Abu Dhabi Emirate, United Arab Emirates
jobs.description: The Strategy Management Office is building a bench of specialist associates for independent quality and assurance reviews in UAE higher education and the public sector. We're looking for a CISA-qualified IT auditor to lead the information systems and data controls work on these engagements, alongside our academic quality team, which includes a former Commissioner of the Commission for Academic Accreditation. What the work involves • Mapping regulator data requirements to the systems, fields and owners that hold them, and grading data quality on ISO/IEC 25012 • Testing platform controls on student information systems: privileged access, change management, backup and restore, logging • Testing entity-level controls: access and segregation of duties, status and cohort coding, and data lineage from student record to reported KPI • Writing evidence-based findings that institutions and regulators can act on What you'll bring • Current CISA certification (ISACA) • Audit experience with student information systems (Ellucian Banner ideally) or comparable application and data-lineage audits • Familiarity with the ISACA ITAF method • Based in the UAE, or able to work here; all client data is processed in the UAE • Higher education or public sector experience is a plus This is an associate role, engaged per assignment, with the first assignment scheduled for January–February 2027 in Abu Dhabi. Applications are reviewed as they arrive. Send your CV, your CISA certificate number and your availability to info@thesmo.me with the subject "CISA IT Audit Associate".
